source_quote: 19 Production incident An agent running in a real organisation did real damage — data destroyed, an unauthorised action taken, something sent that should not have been. 29 Security exploit The agent was turned against its owner: prompt injection, sandbox escape, poisoned memory or tools, malicious skills and MCP servers. 7 Tool defect The agent tooling itself broke — a regression, an outage, a destructive bug, a release rolled back. 5 Programme failure The deployment failed rather than the agent: pilots abandoned, rollouts halted, agents banned internally.
